meta.name: dask
meta.description: Scales pandas, NumPy, and custom Python research workflows beyond memory or across clusters with Dask. Covers DataFrames, Arrays, Bags, Futures, chunking, schedulers, and distributed diagnostics. Use for partitioned file processing, scientific array computation, or parallel tasks whose memory and dependency structure require Dask.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把超出内存的 pandas/NumPy 计算拆分任务,在本地或集群上并行跑完。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果数据量大到单机内存装不下,还想继续用 pandas 和 NumPy 的写法。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your data outgrows one machine's memory but you still want pandas and NumPy.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把你的 pandas/NumPy 代码改写成 Dask 版本：读多个文件、按分块并行计算、选调度器，处理超出内存或跨机器的数据；操作是惰性的，调用 compute() 才真正执行。
howto.when: 当数据超过可用内存、需要把 pandas/NumPy 操作扩展到多核或多机，或要并行处理多个 CSV、Parquet、JSON 文件时触发。

say.text: 这段 pandas 代码内存装不下，帮我改成 Dask 版本
say.note: 会按分块改写，并提示别先本地读全量数据

say.text: 把 logs/*.json 用 Dask Bag 清洗后转成 DataFrame
say.note: 先做非结构化过滤，再转结构化分析

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude rewrites your pandas/NumPy code to run on Dask: reading multi-file data, chunked parallel computation with DataFrames, Arrays, Bags and Futures, and picking a scheduler. Work stays lazy until you call compute().
howto.when_en: Triggers when data exceeds available RAM, pandas/NumPy work must scale across cores or machines, or you need parallel processing of many CSV/Parquet/JSON files.

say_en.text: Use Dask to read data/*.csv into one DataFrame and compute group means
say_en.note: Builds a lazy task graph; results come at compute()

say_en.text: This pandas code doesn't fit in memory, rewrite it with Dask
say_en.note: Rewrites by partitions; warns against loading locally first

say_en.text: Clean logs/*.json with a Dask Bag, then convert to a DataFrame
say_en.note: Filters unstructured data, then converts for analysis
